title: EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN Structural Remediation: London Open Delay and 61.8% Entry Hardening
research_question: Does applying the structural remediation that improved GBPUSD — delaying the London-open trading window (InpLondonOpen=11) and requiring candle rejection or MACD confirmation at the 61.8% Fibonacci level (InpRequire618Rejection=true) — reduce whipsaw losses and improve performance on EURUSD across the frozen 2026 UNSEEN dataset?
hypothesis: Requiring a later London session start (InpLondonOpen=11 vs 8) and stronger 61.8% Fibonacci confirmation (InpRequire618Rejection=true vs false) will reduce EURUSD's 2026 unseen whipsaw/counter-trend losses without altering the underlying strategy architecture.

facts: In EXP-0049 (EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN baseline), the unthrottled champion generated -$371.27 net profit, PF 0.81 across 74 trades with max drawdown of 8.24% ($852.87).
In GBPUSD 2026 UNSEEN testing, shifting InpLondonOpen from 8 to 11 turned EXP-0061 profitable (+$259.33, PF 1.23, WR 56.0%).
In GBPUSD 2026 UNSEEN testing, enabling InpRequire618Rejection boosted EXP-0065 profitability to +$369.98 (PF 1.51, WR 61.11%, DD 3.23%).
inferences: EURUSD may suffer from similar early European session opening whipsaws during the 08:00-11:00 server window.
61.8% Fibonacci entries on EURUSD may benefit from price action confirmation (candle rejection or MACD) to filter false breakouts.
evidence: EXP-0049 gross loss was -$1,981.54 across 74 trades on EURUSD 2026 UNSEEN.
EXP-0065 showed 35.3% reduction in gross loss on GBPUSD by combining London open delay and 61.8% entry hardening.

independent_variables.name: InpLondonOpen
independent_variables.rationale: Delays trading start to 11:00 server time to bypass opening whipsaws.

independent_variables.name: InpRequire618Rejection
independent_variables.rationale: Requires candle rejection or MACD confirmation at 61.8% Fibonacci retracement level.

assumptions: The EURUSD market dynamics on M30 respond similarly to session timing adjustments as GBPUSD.
The strategy architecture remains unmodified and operates under identical risk parameters (InpRiskPct=1.0%).
falsification_conditions: Total trade count drops below 10 trades across the 9-month window.
